label: übernehmen

edition.check: Level 5: barcode 4019593960000 is valid EAN-13 and matches exactly in MusicBrainz (release 15996385) and Discogs (3057907) (MET); format CD and artist Bushido match (MET); but the only other edition in the same release group with a different barcode/tracklist is excluded by barcode, and no other edition shares the same barcode (MET). However, the requirement of >=2 independent sources for the barcode is met by MB + Discogs + musik-sammler (EAN 4019593960000 in musik-sammler), so level 5 conditions appear MET; no competing edition with the same barcode found. Rating 5 is justified by barcode-matching across multiple databases. Caveat: the musik-sammler EAN match is taken from the scraped page (tl-scrape output line 'EAN-Nr. | 4019593960000').
edition.summary: Barcode 4019593960000 (valid check digit) matches exactly the 2004 CD in MusicBrainz, Discogs and musik-sammler.de with CD format and Bushido as artist, and no other edition carries that barcode.

tracklist.check: Level 5: MusicBrainz and Discogs agree on 20 titles and order; musik-sammler.de (tool 14) also lists all 20 in the same order, and the CAA back cover (tool 7/17) confirms order and titles (MET). Spelling variants only (Pitbull/Pittbull) and small duration deviations do not change count, order or titles. Level 5 conditions MET.
tracklist.summary: Four sources (MusicBrainz, Discogs, musik-sammler.de, back-cover image) agree on 20 tracks in the same order with spelling-only variants.

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 85% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 3 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 85% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 3 conflicts

sources.check: Level 5: database entries (MusicBrainz, Discogs) plus an independent primary source (back-cover image read via tl-vision, printed label/cover text with LC 13533 and EAN) of the same edition are present (MET). The back-cover reading was done by a vision model on a CAA image and the agent could not view the image itself (tool 10 note), which weakens the primary-source claim somewhat, but the printed barcode and catalog number were read. Level 5 is arguable; given the agent's own admission that it could not view the image directly, I rate 4 to be strict.
sources.summary: Two independent database entries plus a collector site with matching EAN, though the back-cover primary-source reading rests on an unverified vision output rather than direct viewing.

concerns: Result confidence was lowered from 0.95 to 0.93 only to satisfy a validator warning, while the written reasoning claims high confidence; the adjustment was cosmetic.

The agent states it could not view the CAA back-cover image itself (tool 10); the back-cover data rests on tl-vision output, and the agent's own tl-vision second reading flagged OUTRO (ersguterdevin) as uncertain [unsicher].

Duration conflicts at tracks 10, 15, 16 are resolved by preferring MusicBrainz; musik-sammler.de values differ from MusicBrainz at track 10 (3:25 vs 205.72 s) and track 19 (3:56 vs 236.97 s) and track 9, and these were not flagged as conflicts; track 19 duration is 3:56 on musik-sammler but 3:57 in MB.

The result's track count and total: MB total 3721 s vs result total_duration_s 3720 and musik-sammler total 61:54 (3714 s by Discogs); the stated total 3720 s is not exactly the MusicBrainz sum, a minor inconsistency.

Track 11 title spelling: the result writes 'Pitbull' in the output tracks while the back cover prints 'PITTBULL' and the reasoning claims printed spelling was adopted; the output keeps 'Pittbull' as in the reasoning but the tracks list uses 'Pittbull' only partially, creating an internal inconsistency.

hitparade.ch listing of the 2001 MC shows different track 15 (Outro) and track 16, and 2005 2-CD lists another tracklist; the agent dismissed hitparade as not the same edition, which is reasonable since EAN/catno differ, but the 2005 2-CD shares catalogue prefix 40195 9396003-1 and was not fully excluded in the output alternatives beyond 'gekürzt'.
